1.0.0.en: First release. Shows live grid, household and solar power, tracks energy imported, exported and produced, and adds Flow cards for exporting to the grid, covering your own demand and solar production. Includes a dashboard widget showing power flowing between the grid, your home and your panels.

1.0.1.en: Changed the layout of the widget.

1.0.2.en: Fixed potential crash senerio in widget.

1.0.3.en: fixed bug that caused a crash, updated app icon

1.0.4.en: Added a time delay variable to keep flows from over writing

1.0.5.en: Improved Sense token renewal and added in-place device repair with MFA, preserving existing devices and energy totals. Reuse recent authentication when adding device types, added Timeline updates for grid export, production, self-sufficiency, and repair recovery, and refreshed both driver icons.
